title: Fixed authored two-checkpoint private-memory observation v0
description: Closed example-only selection, bounded two-checkpoint capture, and independent record verification. The fixed authored probe changes one selected private data-page byte between two cooperative SIGSTOPs. The schema constrains record structure and each checkpoint/range occurrence; the independent checker must reconstruct source and digest bindings, raw bytes, object identity, timing order and byte relations. These observations authenticate neither whole process memory, physical residency, the kernel, observer history nor original launcher or selected runtime execution.
